description: Zoe Martinez pitches and attempts to close a social media management service contract with Betty Kowalski's Auto Row Diner. Rate: $120/month for one post per day, community-focused content. Zoe walks in during non-rush hours and makes the pitch in person, showing her TikTok from tick 1 as proof of voice and framing the value proposition around the spending index collapse: 'Businesses that stay humanly visible on social media have a measurable edge over ones that go dark.'

resources.detail: Monthly social media management service - $120/month. One post per day, community-focused tone, engagement management.

if_rejected.note: Zoe immediately pivots to next closest small business on auto row same day
